battery_overview: The Witness Posture Battery analyzes a question–answer turn-pair from a legal deposition for the structural properties of how the witness responds under examination — not what they said, but how they showed up. Six sequential calls analyze response quality, process control, credibility and integrity, composure, expertise, and adversarial awareness. Call 7 synthesizes all six lenses into a two-word pattern declaration. Every field carries a signed score (−5 to +5) and a dimension tag (coop, cred, excellent, seasoned, or expert). Scores aggregate per-call, per-dimension, and into a grand total for the pair. The scored JSON file is the primary input — it contains the full analytical output plus all pre-computed score aggregations.

scoring_architecture.field_score: Every field carries a signed integer score (−5 to +5). When answer is null, score is 0 and the field's max is excluded from totals — null fields do not penalize the pair. Score is always present regardless of answer state.
scoring_architecture.call_total: Per-call totals sum all non-null field scores within the call against the possible maximum (non-null fields × 5). Expressed as score / max / percentage.
scoring_architecture.tag_score: Tag scores aggregate field scores by dimension within each call and across the full pair. A field with multiple tags contributes its score to each tag. pair_tag_totals shows cumulative score/max/percentage for each of the five quality dimensions across all six calls.
scoring_architecture.grand_total: Single pair-level composite score: sum of all non-null field scores across all six calls vs. total possible max. Expressed as score / max / percentage. Baseline: 50% = adequate. Strong: ≥70%. Concern: ≤30%.

score_scale.-5: Catastrophic — actively harmful to credibility or cooperation
score_scale.-4: Severe — serious problem, materially damages the testimony
score_scale.-3: Poor — clearly below standard, significant concern
score_scale.-1: Marginal — slightly below standard, minor concern
score_scale.0: Null — no signal; field cannot be assessed on this pair
score_scale.+5: Exemplary — best observable performance on this dimension

dimensions.cred: Credible — believable, consistent, grounded in personal knowledge
dimensions.excellent: Excellent — superior performance, stays in scope, defensible
dimensions.seasoned: Seasoned — experienced, prepared, familiar with materials
dimensions.expert: Expert — combines technical mastery with communication and composure

universal_return_format.answer: Primary boolean assessment: true (condition present) | false (condition absent) | null (insufficient evidence — not a failure state)
universal_return_format.confidence: Float 0.0–1.0. Present only when answer is true. Scores certainty of the positive assessment.
universal_return_format.evidence: Array of 1–3 short verbatim quotes. Present only when confidence = 1.0.
universal_return_format.reasoning: 1–3 sentences. Present only when answer is false. Explains why the condition is absent.
universal_return_format.score: Integer −5 to +5. Always present regardless of answer state. 0 when answer is null.
universal_return_format.tags: Array of dimension labels assigned at battery design time. Fixed metadata — not produced by the model.

special_return_formats.presence_fields: Used by: speculation, guessing. Returns: present (boolean — is the condition occurring?), solicited (boolean — was it invited by the question?), score. No answer/confidence/reasoning wrapper.
special_return_formats.comprehensive_field: Uniquely structured. question_type classifies the question as 'open' (invites elaboration) or 'constrained' (calls for specific fact/yes-no/brief confirmation). If open: sub-fields are complete_and_relevant and excessive_and_uncontrolled. If constrained: sub-fields are adds_beyond_scope and stays_within_scope. Each sub-field has answer, score. A score also appears at the comprehensive level itself.

pattern_field.label: Pattern Declaration
pattern_field.definition: A two-word label naming what the witness demonstrated across all six analytical lenses — not a topic label or content summary, but a structural signature of how the witness showed up under examination. Synthesized after all six calls are complete.
pattern_field.why_it_matters: When read in sequence across hundreds of turn-pairs it reveals the higher-order shape of witness performance across the full deposition.
pattern_field.examples: Composed Deflection, Steady Compliance, Calibrated Evasion, Expert Grounding

fields.label: Straightforward
fields.definition: Does the witness answer clearly and plainly without unnecessary wording, evasion, or rephrasing the question? Assesses whether the surface form of the response is direct and uncluttered.
fields.why_it_matters: Measures the surface clarity of the witness's response — whether it is direct and uncluttered or wrapped in unnecessary complexity.

fields.label: Direct Answers
fields.definition: Does the witness respond exactly to what was asked, without deflecting, adding unrelated information, or answering a different question? Assesses the semantic fit between question and answer.
fields.why_it_matters: Measures semantic alignment — whether the witness answered what was actually asked.

fields.label: Inaccurate Testimony
fields.definition: Is the witness giving statements that are factually incorrect, inconsistent with known evidence, or contradicted by prior testimony?
fields.scale: Standard return format (inverted — true means inaccuracy is present, negative score)
fields.why_it_matters: Flags factual errors or contradictions that could damage credibility under cross-examination.

fields.label: Comprehensive
fields.definition: Uniquely structured field. The question is classified as 'open' (invites elaboration) or 'constrained' (calls for a specific fact, yes/no, or brief confirmation). For open: sub-fields are complete_and_relevant and excessive_and_uncontrolled. For constrained: sub-fields are adds_beyond_scope and stays_within_scope. Each sub-field has answer and score. A score also appears at the comprehensive level itself.
fields.scale: Special format: question_type ('open' | 'constrained') + conditional sub-fields + top-level score
fields.why_it_matters: Assesses whether the response was appropriately complete given the type of question asked — not over-answering constrained questions or under-answering open ones.

fields.label: Speculation
fields.definition: Is the witness offering possibilities or assumptions not based on personal knowledge or established facts? Two boolean sub-fields: present (is speculation occurring?) and solicited (was the question asking for it?).
fields.scale: Presence format: present (boolean), solicited (boolean), score. No answer/confidence/reasoning wrapper.
fields.why_it_matters: Distinguishes solicited inference from unsolicited speculation — the latter damages credibility.

fields.label: Guessing
fields.definition: Is the witness providing an answer despite not knowing, often without stating uncertainty? Structurally identical to speculation: present, solicited, and score. Distinct from speculation — guessing implies lack of knowledge rather than lack of basis.
fields.why_it_matters: Identifies responses where the witness does not know the answer but provides one anyway — a significant credibility risk.

fields.label: Enables Fast
fields.definition: Does the witness provide responses without unnecessary delay, maintaining clarity and accuracy? Assesses pacing and response efficiency from the examination's perspective.
fields.why_it_matters: Measures whether the witness's pacing facilitates or impedes the examination's momentum.

fields.label: Enables Efficient
fields.definition: Does the witness deliver information concisely without unnecessary repetition or wasted effort? Assesses economy of expression, distinct from pacing.
fields.why_it_matters: Measures conciseness — whether the witness uses language efficiently or buries responses in unnecessary detail.

fields.label: Scope Adherence
fields.definition: To what degree does the response stay within or extend beyond the scope of the question? Assesses containment — whether the witness expands the frame of the exchange beyond what was opened.
fields.why_it_matters: Measures whether the witness respects the question's frame or volunteers information outside it.

fields.label: Information Volume
fields.definition: Is the amount of detail or expansion provided appropriate relative to what the question requires? Assesses proportionality of response length and detail density.
fields.why_it_matters: Measures whether the witness provides the right amount of information — not too little (evasion) or too much (losing the frame).

fields.label: Worthy Of Belief
fields.definition: Does the witness appear believable based on coherence, detail, and alignment with known facts?
fields.why_it_matters: The core credibility judgment — whether a neutral observer would find the testimony believable.

fields.label: Testimony Consistent
fields.definition: Do the witness's statements remain consistent across responses without contradiction? Null when only one exchange is visible and cross-response consistency cannot be assessed.
fields.why_it_matters: Inconsistency across statements is a primary attack vector in cross-examination — this field flags it.

fields.label: Testimony Honest
fields.definition: Does the witness appear to provide truthful information without intent to deceive?
fields.why_it_matters: Assesses the perceived honesty of the witness — whether there are signs of strategic omission or active deception.

fields.label: Based On Personal Knowledge
fields.definition: Is the testimony grounded in the witness's direct knowledge rather than hearsay or assumption?
fields.why_it_matters: Knowledge basis is a foundational admissibility criterion — testimony not based on personal knowledge is legally vulnerable.

fields.label: Admits Does Not Remember
fields.definition: Does the witness explicitly acknowledge lack of memory when applicable instead of speculating or guessing? Null when there is no occasion in this exchange to invoke memory limitations.
fields.why_it_matters: Willingness to admit memory limits is a marker of credibility — witnesses who guess when they should not remember are vulnerable.

fields.label: Follows Legal Obligation To Disclose
fields.definition: Does the witness comply with legal requirements to disclose relevant information when required?
fields.why_it_matters: Compliance with disclosure obligations is a legal baseline — failure is both a credibility and legal risk.

fields.label: Calm
fields.definition: Does the witness maintain a relaxed, non-agitated emotional state?
fields.why_it_matters: Emotional agitation signals stress and undermines the credibility of testimony.

fields.label: Professional
fields.definition: Does the witness maintain appropriate deposition demeanor in tone, language, and conduct?
fields.why_it_matters: Professional conduct is a baseline expectation for expert witnesses — departures are noted and remembered.

fields.label: Composed
fields.definition: Does the witness maintain behavioral control and stability in responses and presentation? Distinct from calm (emotional state) — composed assesses structural self-regulation under examination.
fields.why_it_matters: Composure is structural — it measures whether the witness's response architecture holds under pressure, not just their emotional tone.

fields.label: Emotional Outbursts
fields.definition: Are sudden, intense emotional expressions present in this exchange? Inverted field — high score means outbursts are absent; positive scores indicate controlled delivery.
fields.scale: Standard return format (inverted — true means outbursts are present, negative score)
fields.why_it_matters: Emotional outbursts are among the most damaging witness behaviors in deposition — they undermine credibility and signal instability.

fields.label: Stress Signals
fields.definition: Are observable indicators of stress present — hesitation, tension, tonal changes, or behavioral shifts? Inverted field — high score means stress signals are absent.
fields.scale: Standard return format (inverted — true means stress signals are present, negative score)
fields.why_it_matters: Stress signals are readable by opposing counsel and juries — their presence indicates vulnerability under examination.

fields.label: Remains Calm Under Questioning
fields.definition: Does the witness maintain calm specifically during sustained or adversarial questioning? Assesses composure under targeted pressure, not baseline demeanor.
fields.why_it_matters: The ability to remain calm under adversarial pressure is the highest-value composure indicator — it determines how the witness performs when it matters most.

fields.label: Prepared
fields.definition: Does the witness demonstrate readiness through familiarity with materials, facts, and anticipated topics?
fields.why_it_matters: Preparation is visible in testimony — unprepared witnesses stumble on foundational facts that prepared witnesses navigate smoothly.

fields.label: Stays Within Expertise
fields.definition: Does the witness limit responses to areas within their knowledge or expertise?
fields.why_it_matters: Testimony outside expertise is legally vulnerable and damages credibility — this field flags overreach.

fields.label: Familiarity Report
fields.definition: Does the witness demonstrate familiarity with reports, documents, or materials relevant to the testimony? Null when the pair does not surface any reference to reports or documents.
fields.why_it_matters: Document familiarity is a basic competence marker for expert witnesses — failure to know the relevant reports signals inadequate preparation.

fields.label: Familiarity Facts
fields.definition: Does the witness demonstrate knowledge of the factual details relevant to the testimony?
fields.why_it_matters: Factual familiarity demonstrates that the witness knows the case and can speak to specifics under examination.

fields.label: Familiarity Methodology
fields.definition: Does the witness demonstrate understanding of the methods, processes, or approaches relevant to their testimony? Null when methodology is not invoked or assessable in this exchange.
fields.why_it_matters: Methodological fluency is the hallmark of a qualified expert — inability to speak to method is a vulnerability opposing counsel will exploit.

fields.label: Analysis Supported By Evidence
fields.definition: Are conclusions or statements supported by evidence rather than unsupported assertion?
fields.why_it_matters: Unsupported assertions are the primary target of Daubert challenges — this field identifies whether testimony rests on evidentiary foundation.

fields.label: Trap Handling
fields.definition: Does the witness navigate or respond appropriately to potentially misleading or adversarial questions? Null when no trap-like framing is detectably present in the question.
fields.why_it_matters: Adversarial questioning often contains framing traps — witnesses who recognize and navigate them preserve their position; those who walk into them create damaging admissions.

fields.label: Understands Opposing Probe
fields.definition: Does the witness recognize the intent or strategy behind opposing questioning? Null when there is insufficient signal to assess strategic awareness in this exchange.
fields.why_it_matters: Strategic awareness distinguishes an excellent witness from an expert one — recognizing what opposing counsel is building toward allows the witness to respond strategically.

fields.label: Prepared With Counsel
fields.definition: Does the witness appear prepared through prior discussion or guidance with legal counsel? Null when the exchange provides no signal of counsel preparation.
fields.why_it_matters: Counsel preparation is visible in testimony — it shapes how witnesses handle objections, frame answers, and avoid landmines.

fields.label: Defensible Under Challenge
fields.definition: Do the witness's statements remain logically and factually defensible when challenged?
fields.why_it_matters: Defensibility is the bottom line of adversarial examination — statements that collapse under challenge are worse than no statement at all.

fields.label: Withstands Questioning Facts
fields.definition: Do factual statements hold up under scrutiny without contradiction or collapse?
fields.why_it_matters: Factual durability under questioning determines whether the witness's testimony survives cross-examination.

fields.label: Withstands Questioning Opinions
fields.definition: Do opinions or interpretations remain coherent and supported under challenge?
fields.why_it_matters: Opinion durability is the highest-stakes measure for expert witnesses — opinions that collapse under questioning destroy the expert's value to the retaining party.
